verdict.rationale: Apify's Actor marketplace and public REST API (openapi.json) mean a developer could run a scraping Actor and retrieve HTML via one API call, but no evidence item explicitly documents a single-call 'get raw HTML' endpoint or a specific ready-made scraper Actor's output format. Missing for 10: explicit docs/example showing an API call that returns raw HTML, and any hands-on confirmation of extraction quality/fidelity for that use case.
